description: Chunky flat cartoon machinery with bold deep teal outlines and oversized readable attachments. Menus use a forest green alien sky with a ringed planet and distant salvage cranes; combat uses muted sage dirt with tracks and scrap piles. The hero has warm ochre armor and cream highlights. Hazards glow coral and salvage shines mint. Metal plaques and amber mechanical buttons frame the UI. Use top-down gameplay and a large illustrated robot for menus.
